[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Find Target Indices After Sorting Array** [LC 2089 · Find Target Indices After Sorting Array](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-target-indices-after-sorting-array/){difficulty="Easy"}

After sorting, equal values sit together, so the target's indices are one **contiguous run**. "Which indices hold $t$?" becomes "where does the block of $t$'s start and end?", and those two ends are `bisect_left` (the first index $\ge t$) and `bisect_right` (the first index $> t$): `range(lo, hi)` *is* the answer. Even the sort is optional, because the run starts after the elements smaller than $t$ and is as long as the number of $t$'s.

[Solved in full in @sec-bst-p1-b.]{.card-link}

:::
